verdict.rationale: Vanta's core product runs continuous automated tests, evidence collection, and monitoring in the background (vanta-docs-10, vanta-docs-45, vanta-docs-49), and its AI/TPRM Agents autonomously draft policies, complete questionnaires, discover vendors, and flag issues without manual triggering (vanta-docs-13, vanta-docs-15, vanta-docs-36). Webhooks further support event-driven automation instead of polling (vanta-docs-4). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of autonomous scheduling behavior and clearer documentation on user-configurable automation triggers/schedules beyond marketing claims.
